market_question: Will Kolkata Knight Riders win the 2026 Indian Premier League?
reasoning: KKR is a historically strong IPL franchise which just won the 2024 title. In a 10-team league, even the weakest side would have about 5% chance; KKR's true probability is likely around 9% or higher. The market's 1.3% implied probability is a gross mispricing, offering a huge edge on the Yes side.
evidence_points: 10-team IPL format gives any average team roughly a 10% baseline chance
KKR are the defending champions (2024) and retain key stars like Rinku Singh, Russell, Narine
The market price of 1.3% is far below any realistic estimate for a major franchise
Mega auction before 2025 season set rosters for 2025-2027; KKR still built a competitive squad
sources_consulted: General knowledge of IPL structure and franchise history
Recent news about IPL 2025 mega auction and team compositions
